title: Yummy German Salt Cod Sandwich
description: A charred, springy sandwich that celebrates German flavors, featuring tender salt cod, buttery double-rise bread, and a tangy dill mustard spread.
instructions: Rinse the salt cod under cold water and pat dry.
Place the cod in a saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a gentle simmer for 4 minutes to rehydrate and partially cook; then drain.
Using a fork, flake the cod into bite‑size pieces and transfer to a bowl.
In the same bowl, whisk together the mustard, dill, lemon juice, sea salt, and pepper until combined.
Toss the flaked cod with the mustard mixture until evenly coated.
Heat a skillet over medium‑high heat and melt 1 tablespoon of butter; add two slices of bread and toast each side until golden and slightly charred, about 2 minutes per side.
Spread a thin layer of the mustard‑cod mixture over one toasted slice, then top with cucumber slices.
Place the second toasted slice on top, cut the sandwich in half, and serve immediately.
Optionally garnish with a sprig of dill and a lemon wedge.
